title: Nearest Depot
story: Delivery vans leave from several depots and drive along one-way roads between numbered villages. For every village, how many roads does a van need from the nearest depot that can reach it? A depot's own village needs 0, and a village no van can reach reports -1. With hundreds of depots, the planner cannot afford a separate search from each one.

notes: Depots are villages; one may be listed twice.

hints: A search from every depot, keeping the smallest distance for each village, is correct but repeats almost all of its work.
Put every depot into the same queue at distance 0 before you start: one breadth-first search then grows from all of them at once.
The first time a village is reached, it is reached from its nearest depot; never change it afterwards.
